title: Exclude 126 fixed-port two-ingress repairs at P104 adjoint chart 3
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The two existing paid rank-three legs at slots `97760` and `95681` on the #7786 adjoint word would be replaced by one rank-six send from chart 768 to chart 3. Two already-paid ingresses can then be recoded with their original ranks, with `99128` still produced at chart 508. Adjoint chart 3 has only terminal readers. The proof tests all 126 shortlisted choices for the other ingress while retaining the other 905 receiver rows and the original causal availability restrictions.

Exact probes exclude 76 original producer stocks. The other 50 can give equal nonzero responses and still fail to restore three independent quotient directions. For those 50, the rank-six sender and chart 508 can supply only the same old `99128` line modulo the held rows. One more arrival adds at most one direction. The proposed path's gross price improvement is about `0.770182622274303245` signed units across 48 calls. The exact realizable credit in this scope is zero.

## Task and overlap

The `p104-side-correction` card is refined to the published two-probe shortlist on #7786 head `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`. The archived word and layout match the public Git blobs and SHA-256 pins. This PR covers adjoint chart 3 under the fixed two-ingress contract. PR #7795 supplies related source-graph verification and the separately scoped chart-127 paid-slot repairs and linked cone bounds. [Opening claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19754206) · [Frozen shortlist and signed probes](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19749615) · [Related PR #7795](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7795)

## Validation

The package runs using standard-library CPython 3.12 with no network access. Run from its directory.

```sh
python3.12 -IB verify_pulses.py
python3.12 -IB verify_certificate.py
python3.12 -IB verify_primal.py
```

The two exact verifiers use independent primal and adjoint reconstructions and different prime moduli for lower-rank minors. They check the rational decomposition identities and the complete 76/50 result. Both probes include a literal retirement control with a change at 165 terminals. The adjoint replay also rejects a doubled restoration coefficient. The three direct commands completed in about 31 CPU seconds and 163 MiB peak RSS.

The inherited conditional lower is `0.00387944011068`. The submitted target is `0.00387981257853`. The proof bounds the fixed-port replacements in this finite roster. Any change to the source charts, readers, number of funded ingresses or original available stocks needs a new proof and complete application accounting.

## Credit

Clear1nsight prepared the results with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including the independent exact reviews. Credit #7786/#7781 for the predecessor words, Ali Romman's #7776 for the signed caller and #7774 for the restored chain. The source and verifier notices preserve the detailed attribution.

## Open next questions

For one same-grade relocation, recompute the causal stock and the three required quotient directions before attempting a changed literal word. A replacement has to restore every existing reader and fit the complete signed and ordinary application bills.
